subject.title: fix(signal): restore native replies for Signal sends

question: Should the full delivery-confirmed single-use reply transaction be retained while resolving this PR onto current main?
rationale: The branch changes a shared runtime delivery contract and conflicts with independently evolved current-main code, so tests cannot determine the intended permanent scope or conflict resolution.

options.title: Integrate full invariant
options.body: Port the Signal state and complete reservation/commit/release transaction into current-main structures with broad sibling validation.

options.title: Narrow to Signal
options.body: Carry forward only Signal-owned quote persistence and native send translation while retaining current shared reply semantics.

options.title: Split the work
options.body: Use separate clean PRs for Signal quote state and the shared delivery transaction so each owner boundary can be reviewed independently.

recommendation.title: Integrate full invariant
recommendation.body: Port the Signal state and complete reservation/commit/release transaction into current-main structures with broad sibling validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history most strongly connects this owner to the overlapping shared reply, session, and message-action contracts.
